info.title: yebeyt API
info.description: Errors are `{ "error": code }`; the apps turn the codes into Persian copy.

refreshToken.description: Opaque, valid 60 days, single use: every refresh returns a new one.

allowedAt.description: With username_change_too_soon: when the next change is allowed.

nonce.description: The raw nonce; its sha256 was sent to Apple. Required: the identity token must carry its sha256.

fullName.description: Accepted and ignored: the server keeps no names.

displayName.description: 1–30 characters after trimming, no control characters.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

key.description: The couplet, for a like or a repost.

date.description: The Tehran day, for a daily result.

tries.description: Tries it took, for a daily result.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

messageId.description: One of their messages in a chat I am in.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page.

reporter.description: Null after the reporter deleted their account.

message.description: The reported message; null when the report is of the person, or the message is gone.

online.description: Connected right now; null when they do not let others see it («آنلاین» off).

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

key.description: A couplet message's couplet key; the app shows its first hemistich.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for older messages; null at the start of the chat.

otherReadMessageId.description: The last message the other person has read («دیده شد» up to it); null if none.

key.description: `couplet` messages only: the couplet to show.

note.description: `couplet` messages only: the optional note that came with it.

payload.description: `system` and `game` messages: `{ event, ... }`, e.g. `{ event: "divan_add", key }`.

deleted.description: The sender deleted it; text, key, note and payload are then null.

clientId.description: Made by the phone for each message; sending it again returns the same message, so a retry never doubles it.
Made by the phone for each message; sending it again returns the same message, so a retry never doubles it.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

league.description: This week's tier; null before their first score of the week, and for a stranger who keeps off the global leaderboard (same rule as `weekPoints`).

weekPoints.description: Only for a friend, for yourself, or someone who allows the global leaderboard; else null.

roundId.description: Made by the phone for each round; sending it again does not count twice.

league.description: This week's tier; before the first score of the week, the tier the user will start in.

week.description: The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.

tier.description: 0 نوآموز, 1 بیت‌خوان, 2 غزل‌باز, 3 سخن‌دان, 4 استاد سخن.

endsAt.description: When the week ends (Friday midnight in Tehran).

rows.description: My league group, best first. Empty until my first score of the week.

username.description: Null for someone who has not chosen a username yet, and when `hidden`.

hidden.description: League only: a stranger who keeps off the global leaderboard. Show «یه نفر»; username, name and picture are null, the points are real.

week.description: The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.
The Tehran week, Saturday to Friday.

allOf.description: My own rank, even when I am not on the list (my `inGlobalLeaderboard` is off). Null before my first score of the week.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

version.description: First 12 characters of the picture's sha256; changes when the picture does.

url.description: Path on this server, to be resolved against its address.

uploadToken.description: Random, valid 15 minutes: send it as X-Upload-Token when uploading attachments.

FeedbackRequest.description: Rules per type. bug: text, optional frequency, screen and technical. annoyed: text, optional screen. idea and liked: text only. game: a `game` idea, text optional. appVersion, deviceModel and osVersion go with every type. The body is limited to 32 KB.

FeedbackTechnical.description: Only these keys; anything else is refused.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page.

username.description: Null for guests, for users with no username yet, and after the account is deleted.

get.summary: Is the server up and the database reachable?

401.description: The token is invalid, expired or not for this app.
The token is invalid, expired or not for this app.

post.summary: Swap a refresh token for a new pair
post.description: A refresh token works once. Using one again revokes the whole sign-in.

401.description: The token is invalid, expired or not for this app.

204.description: Signed out (also when the token was unknown).

get.summary: The signed-in user

delete.summary: Delete the account and everything stored for it
delete.description: Also removes its blocks, chats with their messages (the other person loses the chat) and shared divans. Revokes the Apple token when there is one. If Apple cannot be reached the account is kept (502) so the call can be repeated.

502.description: Apple could not be reached; nothing was deleted.

put.description: The name the person shows to friends (from Apple or Google, or typed). Stored only as a display name.

200.description: The user with the new display name.

400.description: invalid_request: empty, longer than 30 characters, or with control characters.

put.description: Six parts, each an id from the app's catalogue (the server checks only their shape). Replaces the whole avatar.

200.description: The user with the new avatar.

400.description: invalid_request: a part is missing, empty, longer than 32 characters or not lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

put.description: Free the first time; later changes only 30 days after the last one.

200.description: The user with the new username.

400.description: The name breaks the rules (username_too_short, username_too_long, username_bad_chars, username_reserved).

get.summary: Points, streak and best scores

put.summary: Add progress made as a guest
put.description: Merged with what is stored, keeping the larger value of each field (and, per game, of each best score).

get.summary: The divan: kept and removed couplets

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

put.summary: Merge the phone's divan into the stored one
put.description: Up to 2000 items per request and 20000 per user. Items with no timestamp are ignored. Per key the later keptAt and the later removedAt win, so a couplet is kept when keptAt is after removedAt. Repeating a request changes nothing. A timestamp more than 5 minutes ahead of the server's clock is refused (bad_timestamp). Answers the full merged state.

200.description: Every item stored for the user.

400.description: invalid_request, or bad_timestamp for a time too far ahead.

413.description: payload_too_large (body over 1 MB), or divan_full (the user would have more than 20 000 items).

get.summary: What my friends did: the home «دوستات» feed
get.description: Newest first, 30 a page, from friends only (people who follow each other). A friend's likes and reposts are shown only when their `keptVisibility` is `friends` (the switch that also hides their divan). Their solved daily puzzles are shown only when their `dailyVisibility` is `friends`. Taking back a like, or ending the friendship, removes the item.

put.description: Idempotent. You need a username of your own (403 username_required). Two people who follow each other are friends. If either of you blocked the other, the person is not found (404).

200.description: How we follow each other now.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

200.description: How we follow each other now.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: People I follow, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: `isFriend` is true when they follow me back.

get.summary: People who follow me, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: `isFriend` is true when I follow them back. People with no username yet are left out.

get.summary: My friends (we follow each other), 50 a page
get.description: Ordered by when I followed them, newest first. `isFriend` is always true.

put.description: Idempotent. Removes the follows between the two, both ways. A blocked pair cannot follow, message or share a divan with each other (and cannot invite each other to games), and each is hidden from the other's profile lookup (404) and search. The blocked person is not told.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

delete.description: Idempotent. The follows removed by the block do not come back.

404.description: No user with that username.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: People I blocked, newest first, 50 a page

post.summary: Report a person or one of their messages
post.description: For abuse or spam. A report is read by the team; the reported person is not told. 10 reports a minute per user.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad body, or that is yourself.

404.description: No such user, or no such message of theirs in a chat I am in.

429.description: Too many reports (10 a minute per user).

get.summary: Reports, newest first, 50 a page

post.summary: Open the chat with someone (made if it does not exist)
post.description: Allowed when the other person takes messages from everyone («بهم پیام بده: همه»), or from friends and we are friends; otherwise 403 messages_closed. If either of us blocked the other, the person is not found (404). The chat shows in the list once it has a message.

403.description: username_required, or messages_closed: they do not take messages from me.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

get.summary: My chats with the latest message and the unread count, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: Only chats with at least one message, and not with someone blocked either way.

get.summary: How many unread messages I have, for the tab badge
get.description: The other people's messages after the last one I read, in all chats that nobody blocked. System lines and deleted messages do not count.

get.summary: Messages of a chat, newest first
get.description: Only for the two people of the chat. 50 at most per page (`limit`); `before` is the `nextBefore` of the previous page.

400.description: A malformed id, cursor or limit.

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

post.summary: Send a text or a couplet
post.description: `kind` is `text` (`text`, 1–1000 characters) or `couplet` (`key` and an optional `note` of up to 200). Idempotent per sender and `clientId`: a repeat answers 200 with the first message. Blocks and «بهم پیام بده» are checked on every send (403 messages_closed). 30 messages a minute per user. Both people get a live `message` event.

200.description: This client id was already sent; the first message.

403.description: username_required, or messages_closed: blocked, or they do not take messages from me.

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it.

409.description: conflict: the client id was used for a message in another chat.

429.description: Too many messages (30 a minute per user).

put.summary: Mark a chat as read up to a message
put.description: Never moves backwards. The other person gets a live `read` event, which is their «دیده شد».

404.description: No such chat, or I am not in it, or the message is not in it.

delete.description: Idempotent. The message stays in the chat as «deleted»; its text, couplet and note are removed. System lines cannot be deleted.

404.description: No such message, or I am not in its chat.

post.summary: Open the divan I share with a friend (made if it does not exist)
post.description: Only between friends (403 forbidden otherwise). If either of us blocked the other, the person is not found (404).

403.description: username_required, or forbidden: we are not friends.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

get.summary: My shared divans with their counts, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: Not including divans with someone blocked either way.

get.summary: The couplets of a shared divan, newest first, 50 a page
get.description: `by` keeps the ones added by me (`me`), by them (`them`) or all (default). `counts` always count the whole divan. Stays readable if we stop being friends.

404.description: No such divan, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

post.description: Only while we are friends. Puts a system line `{ event: "divan_add", key }` in our chat (made if there is none; it ignores «بهم پیام بده» because we are friends), and both of us get live `message` and `divan` events. Adding a couplet that is already there answers 200 with the item that is there, and adds nothing. 60 a minute per user.

403.description: username_required, or forbidden: we are not friends any more.

404.description: No such divan, or I am not in it, or one of us blocked the other.

429.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per user).

delete.description: Only the person who added it. Its likes go with it.

403.description: forbidden: they added it; or username_required.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

put.summary: Like a couplet of the shared divan
put.description: Idempotent. Either of the two people may like any couplet in it.

200.description: The couplet with the likes now.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

delete.description: Idempotent. Either of the two people may like any couplet in it.

200.description: The couplet with the likes now.

404.description: No such divan or couplet, or I am not in it.

get.summary: Find people by the start of their username
get.description: Case-insensitive prefix match on the username, at least 2 characters, up to 20 results in alphabetical order, never including me or anyone who blocked me or whom I blocked. 60 searches a minute per user.

400.description: invalid_request: shorter than 2 characters after trimming.

429.description: Too many searches (60 a minute per user).

get.summary: A person's public profile
get.description: Name, avatar, how many friends they have, how we follow each other. Their league tier and points this week are given only to a friend, to themselves and when they allow the global leaderboard.

404.description: No user with that username, or one of us blocked the other.

put.description: `kind` is `like` or `repost`. Idempotent. The couplet is the `key` query parameter (no body). A reaction is social by nature: friends see it in their feed. Reposting a couplet is only this reaction.

schema.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).

parameters.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).
parameters.name: key

200.description: The couplet's counts after the change.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad kind or key.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

delete.summary: Take back a like or a repost
delete.description: Idempotent. The couplet is the `key` query parameter (no body).

schema.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).

parameters.description: The couplet key; the `#` must be percent-encoded (`%23`).
parameters.name: key

200.description: The couplet's counts after the change.

400.description: invalid_request: a bad kind or key.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: Likes and reposts of up to 50 couplets
get.description: Everyone's reactions are counted, not only friends'. Every asked key is in the answer, with zeros when nobody reacted.

schema.description: Up to 50 couplet keys, comma separated (the `#` in a key must be percent-encoded).

parameters.description: Up to 50 couplet keys, comma separated (the `#` in a key must be percent-encoded).
parameters.name: keys

400.description: invalid_request: a bad key, or more than 50.

post.description: Idempotent on `roundId` (the same user sending it again gets the stored result and nothing is added; another user's round id is 409 `conflict`). `daily` counts once per user per Tehran day (of `playedAt`) and `onboarding` once per user ever: a second round of either, with a new `roundId`, is 409 `conflict`. `points` over the game's cap is 400 `points_too_high` (daily 100, jigsaw 320, poet, second and book 440, match 50, listen 100, onboarding 50). `playedAt` must be within the last 48 hours and at most 5 minutes ahead (400 `bad_timestamp`). The round counts for the Tehran week the server receives it in, and the first score of a week puts the user in a league group.

200.description: The week and the user's points this week.

409.description: conflict: the round id belongs to another user, or a daily / onboarding round already counted.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

post.description: One result per Tehran day, kept first-write-wins: sending the day again changes nothing and answers the stored result. `date` may be from 48 hours ago (by Tehran date) up to today (400 `bad_timestamp`). `tries` is 1 to 3, also when not solved. The points go in `/v1/scores`.

429.description: Too many requests (120 a minute per user).

get.summary: How my friends did in a day's puzzle
get.description: Friends (people who follow each other) who reported that day, solved first, then by fewer tries, up to 100. A friend whose `dailyVisibility` is `me` is left out, and not counted. `solvedCount` is how many of the listed friends solved it.

get.summary: My points, streak and league
get.description: `totalPoints` and `weekPoints` come from the reported rounds. `streakDays` counts the days in a row the daily puzzle was solved (reported results, Tehran dates), ending today or yesterday; it stays until the day after the missed one ends.

get.summary: My league this week
get.description: Groups of up to 30 people of one tier. A stranger in the group who is not on the global list is `hidden`: no username, name or picture (the app shows «یه نفر»), but their points and rank are real; friends and people on the global list show normally. The first score of a week puts me in a group of the tier I earned last week (tier 0 to begin with). At the week's end the top 5 move up a tier and the bottom 5 down (ties go to the earlier last score). Before my first score of the week `rows` is empty and `tier` is the one I will start in.

get.summary: This week's points: me and my friends
get.description: Friends are people who follow each other. Friends with no score are listed with 0. Best first, then by username; up to 100.

get.summary: This week's points: everyone who allows it
get.description: People with `inGlobalLeaderboard` on (and a username) who scored this week, best first (ties by user id), 50 a page. `me` is my own rank among them, also when I am hidden; null before my first score of the week.

get.summary: Who may see and reach me
get.description: The stored settings, or the defaults when none were stored.

put.description: Only the fields sent change; the rest keep their value (or the default).

get.summary: Is this username free and allowed?
get.description: Case-insensitive. `reason` says why not: too_short, too_long, bad_chars, reserved, taken.

429.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per user).

get.summary: Up to 5 free usernames built from a latin base

200.description: Suggestions (empty when nothing usable is left of the base).

429.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per user).

get.summary: Which poets have a picture, and its version
A poet's picture
get.description: Cached for a day; send If-None-Match with the ETag to get 304.

404.description: No picture for this poet.

put.summary: Upload or replace a poet's picture

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP.

post.summary: Send a report: a bug, something annoying, an idea, a game idea or a thank-you
post.description: Signing in is optional; when signed in the report carries the user (the admin sees the username). Signed-in users may send 10 an hour; all guests together 120 an hour. Nothing about the connection is stored. Answers an upload token for the attachments.

400.description: Breaks the rules for its type.

401.description: A token was sent but it is not valid.

put.summary: Attach a screenshot to a report
put.description: For reports of type bug, annoyed, idea; image/jpeg or image/png, at most 3 MB, and the first bytes must match the declared type; one per report, within 15 minutes of sending it. Hourly budget: 200 MB per signed-in user, 500 MB for all guests' reports together; refused uploads cost nothing. At most 3 uploads are handled at once, and the file must arrive within 60 seconds.

400.description: Empty, or the report's type takes no screenshot.

403.description: Wrong, missing or expired upload token.

404.description: No such report.

408.description: upload_timeout: the file took longer than the time allowed to arrive.

409.description: already_uploaded: this report already has a screenshot.

415.description: Wrong media type, or the file does not start like the declared type.

429.description: rate_limited: the hourly upload budget is used up (200 MB per signed-in user; 500 MB for all guests together).

503.description: busy: too many uploads at once; retry after the Retry-After seconds.

put.summary: Attach a recording to a report
put.description: For reports of type bug; video/mp4, at most 25 MB, and the first bytes must match the declared type; one per report, within 15 minutes of sending it. Hourly budget: 200 MB per signed-in user, 500 MB for all guests' reports together; refused uploads cost nothing. At most 3 uploads are handled at once, and the file must arrive within 60 seconds.

400.description: Empty, or the report's type takes no recording.

403.description: Wrong, missing or expired upload token.

404.description: No such report.

408.description: upload_timeout: the file took longer than the time allowed to arrive.

409.description: already_uploaded: this report already has a recording.

415.description: Wrong media type, or the file does not start like the declared type.

429.description: rate_limited: the hourly upload budget is used up (200 MB per signed-in user; 500 MB for all guests together).

503.description: busy: too many uploads at once; retry after the Retry-After seconds.
